text_markup: The Corp is playing {card:Gagarin Deep Space: Expanding the Horizon}, and the Runner breaches a remote server. When the Runner chooses a candidate from the root of that server, an additional cost to access is imposed. The Runner declines to pay the cost and therefore does not perform the access. That card still ceases to be a candidate.
